newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Index, volume down on Estonian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index, volume down on Estonian bourse.

text.p: Estonia's stock market index dipped on Tuesday and volumes were also lower, dealers said.
Overall market volume was 3.1 million kroons versus almost seven million kroons and the index dipped slightly by 0.01 percent to 97.78.
Shares in leading bank Hansa Bank were the most active at 1.4 million kroons and it closed at 94.30 kroons versus 94.40 kroons on Monday.
Forexbank was the second most active share at 1.2 million kroons and it closed at 77.40, just 0.20 kroons lower than yesterday.
Volume on the secondary free market was just over two million kroons versus 2.4 million kroons on Monday.
Confectionery company Kalevi was the most active on the free market, trading 385,000 kroons and closing at 345.05 kroons versus 320 kroons on Monday.
Dealers said Kalevi was buoyed by its purchase on Monday of 25.5 percent of the shares in Vilniaus Pergale, a Lithuanian sweet maker.

Kalev is to invest 12 million kroons into Pergale and plans to start producing confectionary in Lithuania under the Kalev trade mark, which is well-known throughout many of the former Soviet republics.
